A vehicle securing loans in both Bramble and Northmoor has been confirmed and reported to the lender, and leverage, which would exceed its maximum only if an affiliate guarantee is counted, has been referred for expert review.","sections":[{"heading":"Submissions","text":"We received the May loan tape, May servicer report, May borrowing base certificate, first-quarter financial statements, first-quarter compliance certificate and the second amendment to the facility agreement. The May dealer list was a reused version rather than a new submission."},{"heading":"Reconciliation","text":"The roll-forward expected a pool balance of {{expected}}, against {{actual}} on the May tape, a gap of {{gap}}. The roll-forward identified {{missing}} loans missing from the May tape, and a query has been raised with the submitting party. Charge-offs in the servicer report exceed those on the tape by {{charge_off_difference}}, with {{charge_off_loans}} loans shown as charged off in the report but still live on the tape; this has also been queried with the submitting party. A new column on the May tape has no corresponding platform field, and there are minor gaps in fields not used by any test; both were logged as within tolerance and the field gaps will be raised with the next query."},{"heading":"Borrowing base and terms","text":"We recomputed the May borrowing base at {{borrowing_base}}, giving availability of {{availability}}. The certificate's borrowing base is {{certificate_difference}} above our recomputed figure, a rounding difference within the agreed certificate tolerance of {{tolerance}}, so no alert was raised. The second amendment raises both the facility limit and the dealer limit from June; these changes were logged and require no action."},{"heading":"Triggers and covenants","text":"The rolling delinquency average was {{delinquency_average}}, against a delinquency trigger of {{delinquency_limit}}. The borrower reported leverage of {{leverage_reported}}, against a maximum of {{leverage_limit}}. If the affiliate guarantee of {{guarantee}}, which is kept off the balance sheet, is counted, leverage would be {{leverage_with_guarantee}} and above its maximum. Whether the guarantee should count has been referred for expert review, and the conclusion rests with the reviewer and the lender."},{"heading":"Collateral","text":"We confirmed that one vehicle secures a loan in both Bramble and Northmoor, and the lender has been informed; any further action is for the lender to decide.
